halaman.script: No people. A white marble kitchen countertop in soft morning light. Photorealistic, super realistic food photography, shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft natural window light, true-to-life textures.

The cook: a Muslim woman in a full black burqa-style abaya with a black niqab: loose black sleeves reach all the way to the wrists with fitted cuffs, so no forearm skin shows; a long black khimar falls over her shoulders and chest; a cream linen apron over the abaya; only her clean hands with warm brown skin, short natural nails and no rings are bare; the head and face are never in the frame: the top edge of the image always cuts across her collarbone, so her chin, mouth, nose and eyes are never visible. The cook stands behind the marble counter, framed from the collarbone down to the waist, the top edge of the image cutting across her collarbone, both hands resting on the counter beside a wooden cutting board. A bright modern kitchen: white marble countertop, matte black faucet, light-oak cabinets, a black induction cooktop, soft daylight from a window on the left. Photorealistic, super realistic food photography, shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft natural window light, true-to-life textures.
